requirement_match.summary: Approved email handoff, copy fallback, retained input and original webhook behavior implemented and verified.

security.summary: Browser-only encoded draft; no logging/storage/secrets; controls disabled until hydration to prevent native submission.

code_quality.summary: TypeScript and lint passed; separate browser-safe formatter; no new dependencies.

failure_paths.summary: Desktop/mobile checks cover invalid empty form, denied clipboard, no JavaScript, HTTP error and aborted network with retained fields.

error_handling.summary: User-safe errors preserve data; manual selection and direct email remain accessible; mocked webhook success clears stale data.

production_readiness.summary: Local build and UI checks passed. No deployment; live provider, native email client and inbox receipt unverified. Production limitations disclosed.

trade_offs.summary: Email handoff requires visitor send; URL/client limits mitigated by copy and selectable text. Provider integration stays separately configured.

findings.summary: Pre-hydration default form submission could clear fields and put visitor input in a GET URL. Controls now start disabled and enable after mount. Browser regression must pass.
findings.resolution: Disable controls until hydration completes; desktop and mobile regression rerun passed.
Use useSyncExternalStore with distinct server/client snapshots and no live subscription. Lint and desktop/mobile tests rerun passed.

residual_risks: Email handler support and draft URL size vary; use copy fallback.
limitations: Local browser tests only; webhook responses intercepted and clipboard stubbed.
Native email app and live receipt NOT TESTED; no production deployment.
Review receipt uses legacy declared evidence, not authenticated release-grade assurance.
